# Version  0.1.0a1

#### Code Improvements

* [#29](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/29): Delegate fusion operations to PyKale
* [#34](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/34): Adopt PyKale evaluation metrics in KaleCancer
* [#38](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/38): Adopt PyKale fusion and evaluation in KaleCancer
* [#41](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/41): Add PyKale's repository automation, organise tests by package and unwrap Markdown
* [#42](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/42): Move MOGONET from PyKale

#### Documentation Updates

* [#18](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/18): Establish fusion migration API contract and compatibility baseline

#### Other Changes

* [#13](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/13): Refactor
* [#16](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/16): Make all patient ids a sorted str Index.
* [#19](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/19): Unify patient data access with readable views and tensors.
* [#30](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/30): Add interpretability and survival evaluation to the Pipeline API
* [#31](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/31): Add synthetic classification example.
* [#43](https://github.com/pykale/cancer/pull/43): Add PyKale's repository automation, organise tests by package, unwrap Markdown enhancement, and mogonet migration
